entities.summary: Juan de Salazar, a notable figure in the history of Paraguay, associated with Spanish Conquest and the Jesuit Missions (1524–1600). Their legacy influenced Foundation of Asunción — August 15, 1537 and Buenos Aires re-founded from Asunción.
